title: Sleeping sickness
html_source:
General symptoms include:
Anxiety
Mood changes
Fever
Headache
Weakness
Insomnia at night
Sleepiness during the day (may be uncontrollable)
Sweating
Swollen lymph nodes all over the body
Swollen, red, painful nodule at site of the fly bite
